scenes.title: 7Artisans AF 35mm F1.8: APS-C or full-frame?
scenes.say: Seven Artisans makes two autofocus thirty five millimeter F one point eight lenses for Sony. Which one should you buy?

scenes.title: Autofocus with eye detection
scenes.say: Both autofocus with eye detection, both are F one point eight, and on an APS-C camera both give the same natural field of view.

scenes.title: Small, light, cheap
scenes.say: The APS-C version costs about a hundred and six dollars and weighs around a hundred and eighty grams. Great for crop sensor bodies like the ZV E10.

scenes.title: Metal body, made for video
scenes.say: The full frame version is two thirty nine. You get a metal body, a stepless aperture ring, a function button and a photo video switch, and it works on full frame and APS-C.

scenes.title:
